title: Vintage Resourcify

# Vintage Resourcify `1.7.10` [Resourcify](https://github.com/DeDiamondPro/Resourcify) backport. ![logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintageResourcify/master/images/logo_small.png) [![hub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintageResourcify/master/images/badges/github.png)](https://github.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintageResourcify/releases) [![modrinth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintageResourcify/master/images/badges/modrinth.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/vintage-resourcify) [![curse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintageResourcify/master/images/badges/curse.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/vintage-resourcify) [![67](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintageResourcify/master/images/badges/67.png)](https://67.fentanylsolutions.org/mod/vintage-resourcify) [![mcmodcn](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintageResourcify/master/images/badges/mcmodcn.png)](https://www.mcmod.cn/class/27359.html) [![maven](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintageResourcify/master/images/badges/maven.png)](https://maven.fentanylsolutions.org/#/releases/dev/dediamondpro/resourcify/VintageResourcify) ![forge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintageResourcify/master/images/badges/forge.png) [![cord](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintageResourcify/master/images/badges/cord.png)](https://discord.gg/xAWCqGrguG) ### ⚠️ This project's CurseForge API token has not be approved yet. Please set your own in the config. ### ⚠️ The CurseForge version of this mod does not support downloading from third party Modrinth-compatible platforms. ## Features * Browse, download, remove, update resource packs and shaders ingame * Added resource packs and shader file picker * Drag and drop resource packs and shaders onto their respective screens ([lwjgl3ify](github.com/GTNewHorizons/lwjgl3ify) required) * Support for adding third party Modrinth instances Vintage Resourcify supports Angelica
